name: wimm-css
description: Сборка CSS: Tailwind + daisyui (см. Makefile, target css)

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.daisyui.config.js -i web/styles/input.css -o web/static/daisyui.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i web/styles/input.css -o web/static/tailwind.css --minify
scripts.watch:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.daisyui.config.js -i web/styles/input.css -o web/static/daisyui.css --watch=always & tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i web/styles/input.css -o web/static/tailwind.css --watch=always
